entities.summary: The Kitāb al-Bulhān, or Book of Wonders, is a 14th and 15th century Arabic manuscript, compiled by Hassan Esfahani probably bound during the reign of Jalayirid Sultan Ahmad (1382–1410) in Baghdad. The contents include subjects on astronomy, astrology, and geomancy, including a section of full-page illustrations, with plates dedicated to the discourse topic, e.g. a folktale, a sign of the zodiac, a prophet, etc.
